Answer.a1: Coachera is a mobile app designed to help you build better habits, track progress, and follow personalized coaching programs.
Answer.a2: Whether you're working on mindfulness, fitness, learning, or productivity, Coachera guides you step by step.

q2.Question: How do I sign up for Coachera?

Answer.a1: You can sign up using your email or social media accounts (Google, Facebook).
Answer.a2: Once registered, you can complete your profile and start browsing available courses.

q3.Question: Do I need an internet connection to use Coachera?

Answer.a1: Some features, like course videos and syncing progress, require an internet connection.
Answer.a2: However, downloaded content (if supported) can be accessed offline.

q4.Question: How do I enroll in a course?

Answer.a1: Tap on a course from the main screen, then press the “Enroll” or “Start” button.
Answer.a2: Some courses may require completing prerequisites.

q5.Question: How can I track my progress in a course?

Answer.a1: Your progress is shown as a percentage on the course details page.
Answer.a2: You’ll see checkmarks on completed lessons and chapters.

q6.Question: Can I reset my progress in a course?

Answer.a1: Yes. Go to the course settings and select “Reset Progress.”
Answer.a2: This will remove completion data but keep the course in your enrolled list.

q7.Question: I'm having issues with video playback. What should I do?

Answer.a1: Make sure you have a stable internet connection.
Answer.a2: Try closing and reopening the app. If the issue persists, try updating the app or clearing the app cache from settings.

Answer.a1: Currently, downloading videos may be available only for premium users.
Answer.a2: You can check if the "Download" button appears on the lesson page.

q9.Question: How do I change my password?

Answer.a1: Go to Profile → Settings → Account → Change Password.
Answer.a2: Follow the prompts to update your password.

q10.Question: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?

Answer.a1: On the login screen, tap "Forgot Password" and enter your email.
Answer.a2: A reset link will be sent to your inbox.

q11.Question: How is my personal data protected?

Answer.a1: Coachera uses secure encryption for data storage and transfer.
Answer.a2: Your personal information is never shared without your consent. See our Privacy Policy for details.

q12.Question: How do I get personalized coaching?

Answer.a1: Complete the onboarding quiz when you sign up.
Answer.a2: Based on your goals and preferences, Coachera recommends personalized programs. You can also manually explore and join coaching tracks.

q13.Question: Can I give feedback about a course or the app?

Answer.a1: Yes! Go to Profile → Feedback or use the “Rate this course” option at the end of each module.

q15.Question: How can I cancel my subscription?

Answer.a1: Go to your device’s App Store or Play Store → Subscriptions → Coachera → Cancel.
Answer.a2: Your access will remain active until the end of the billing cycle.
